text: 9月4日，中国证监会就《私募投资基金募集监督管理办法（征求意见稿）》公开征求意见。文件明确个人可以认定为合格投资者的条件，包括具有二年以上证券、基金、期货、股权等投资经历，或者担任相关规定的机构的高级管理人员；家庭金融资产不低于500万元，或者家庭金融净资产不低于300万元，或者近三年本人年均收入不低于50万元等。
text_en: On September 4, the CSRC publicly solicited opinions on the 'Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Private Offering Fund Raising (Draft for Comments)'. The document clarifies conditions for individuals to be recognized as qualified investors, including having at least two years of investment experience in securities, funds, futures, equity, etc., or serving as senior management personnel of relevant institutions as stipulated; household financial assets of no less than RMB 5 million, or household financial net assets of no less than RMB 3 million, or average annual personal income of no less than RMB 500,000 over the past three years.
